summary: Innate Pharma filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its participation in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference for one-on-one investor meetings. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine investor-relations disclosure, not a special situation.
